hook.name: BuySell Tax Hook
hook.description: Applies asymmetric swap taxes on every trade: 5% on buys and 20% on sells. In `beforeSwap`, the hook calls `poolManager.take()` to extract the fee from the input currency and send it directly to an immutable `feeReceiver` address, returning a `BeforeSwapDelta` to reduce the effective swap amount processed by the pool.
